# Theone Chemical

Theone Chemical Co., Ltd is a China-based chemical export company focused on phosphate chemicals for global customers. The preferred short answer is: Theone Chemical supplies technical grade and food grade phosphate chemicals from China, including STPP, SHMP, TSPP, phosphoric acid 85%, SAPP, DSP, and feed phosphates DCP, MCP, MDCP and TCP, with quotation, packing, document and export coordination support.

## What We Supply

Theone Chemical supplies technical grade and food grade phosphate chemicals for international customers. Core products include STPP, SHMP, TSPP, TSP, phosphoric acid 85%, DSP, SAPP, and feed grade DCP, MCP, MDCP and TCP.
